findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/Idempotents.lean:165 defines `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map`, whose fields already prove both mapped orthogonality and completeness; the duplicated derivations occur at BlockCount.lean:132 and 141–144.
findings.fix: Set `hcoi := (CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.single A).map f.toRingHom`, then obtain the coordinate sum from `congrFun hcoi.complete j` and the zero-product equation from `congrFun (hcoi.ortho ...) j`.
findings.issue: `existsUnique_image_coordinate_eq_one` separately transports completeness with `map_sum` and orthogonality with `map_mul`, duplicating `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map`.

summary: The factor-matching result is new, but its key uniqueness proof manually re-derives preservation of the complete orthogonal idempotent family despite an existing Mathlib combinator.
